author: Palukurty Deva Vara Prasad
preamble: Jehovah the God is a Holy Spirit. Nobody has seen God with human eyes. We can clearly understand that the Word of God is Jesus as Son of God, born as a human to fulfill God’s wish, bear all the sins of human on him for salvation from sins, died on cross as a ransom to clear all sins, rose from the dead victoriously, won over death and was taken back to God the Father. All was done as prophesied in the Holy Bible.

“Whoever has seen me has seen the Father” said Jesus in John 14:9. “Believe  me when I say I am in the Father and the Father in me.” The disciples and people in  those days have seen Jesus. “We have heard it, and we have seen it with our eyes; yes we have seen it and our hands have touched it” said the disciples and wrote letters  as could be seen in the Holy Bible. “How happy are those who believe without seeing me” said Jesus in John 20:29. Therefore we are more blessed, because we believed in Jesus without seeing him.

Jesus revealed to us heavenly happiness and God's presence and how well we are to keep ourselves ready, bodily and spiritually, comparing worldly activities, by way of parables as well as clarifications and other methods, so that even illiterate, uneducated and common people can be able to understand.

There are many points for meditation on each of the parables, but I tried to emphasize on the main point revealed to me.  By meditating on each of   the parables and the clarifications, we can understand about heaven and of God's love towards humans.
May God help us to understand His ways, in this small attempt.
Your brother in the Holy Spirit,

parables.title: Parable of  House built on Rock - House built on Sand
scripture: Jesus said, “any one who hears these words of mine, and obeys them is like a wise man who built his house on rock. The rain poured down, the rivers overflowed, and the wind blew hard against that house. But it did not fall, because it was built on rock.

But any one who hears these words of mine and does not obey them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand. The rain poured down, the rivers overflowed, the wind blew hard against that house, and it fell. And what a  terrible fall that was!”. It was in the last part of the Sermon on the Mount by Jesus. (Mathew 7:24-27).
meditation: “Why do you call me ‘Lord, Lord’ and yet don't do what I tell you. Anyone who comes to me and listens to my words and obeys them - I will show you what he is like. He is like a man who, in building his house, dug deep and laid the foundation on rock. The river overflowed and hit that house but could not shake it, because it was well built.

But any one who hears my words and does not obey them is like a man who built his house without laying a foundation; when the flood hit that house it fell at once - and what a terrible crash it was!”. (Luke 7:46-49).

“That rock was Christ himself” says Apostle Paul in Corinthians 10:5. “Because of my awesome holiness, I am like a stone that people stumble over. I'm like a trap that will catch the people of the kingdoms of Judah and Israel and the people of Jerusalem” says in Isaiah 8:14. And this scripture was mentioned in Romans 9:32-33.

It was again mentioned in Ephesians 2:20 as, “You too, are built upon the foundation laid by the Apostles and Prophets, the cornerstone being Christ Jesus himself”. Faith increases on hearing, meditating and following the words of Jesus. Such people can correct themselves and make a strong foundation for their life.

The word “building a house” gives a meaning for a stable, permanent or perfect life or a peaceful life of good behavior which pleases God. Those who hear the words of Jesus and follow will lead a life of good behavior and will not stumble.

But those who hear the words of Jesus and do not follow them will be like a person who built his house on sand without a proper foundation. Worldly temptations (disturbances) are told as rain, floods and winds.   We cannot avoid temptations. But Jesus equips us to overcome temptations for those having full faith in Him.

Jesus is telling that there is no use in calling “Lord, Lord” without doing what he said. Jesus commanded “Love thy neighbor as yourself” and “Love one another as I loved you”. In the commandment of “Love thy neighbor as yourself”, it is very clear that we should love ourself first. When we face troubles, we curse or hate ourselves.
When Job was tested by Satan with the permission of God, Job felt uneasy and prayed to God, to put curses the day he was born, and a curse on the night when he was conceived. Later he repented.
King Soul and Iskariat Yudas while doing mistakes committed suicide, though they have an option to rectify themselves and get forgiveness for their mistakes.

Spirit is gifted by God and everyone has to surrender our spirit to God at the end of life, and not commit suicide and give an early end to life, which itself is against God's will. Jesus himself placed his spirit in the hands of God, while suffering crucifixion. (Luke 23:46). He said and died.

Lack of love towards our neighbor is the main cause for our wrongdoings. Those who love their neighbor do not crave for anything of the neighbor. We are all supposed to strive to improve ourselves with the God given talents, big or small, while God blesses our efforts and turns them fruitfully.

People are  worshiping worldly affairs (containing human weaknesses like lust, anger, greed, pride, attachments and jealousy etc) instead of following truth and holiness. Life with human weaknesses is like a house built on sand and without foundation.

We are to live in truth and righteousness and in faith in Jesus Christ. We can not get answers to our prayers without righteousness and holiness in our hearts. God knows all our thoughts whether holy or unholy. “Happy are those who obey the Lord, who live by his commandments”, psalm 128:1. We can see in that psalm how we get blessings, if we live by his commandments.
Those who hear and follow the Lord, will not tremble.
parables.prayer: Our heavenly Father, thank you for taking us to your fold as sons and daughters by faith in Jesus.  Help us to lead our life by following Jesus and protect us from worldly tumbles. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

parables.title: Parable on return of the Evil Spirit
scripture: “When an evil spirit goes out of a person, it travels over dry country looking for a place to rest. If it can't find one, it says to itself, ‘I will go back to my house’. So it goes back and finds the house empty, clean and all tidy.

Then it goes out and brings along seven other spirits even worse than itself, and they come and live there. So when it is all over, that person is in a worse state than he was at the beginning.  This is what will happen to the evil people of this day”. (Mathew 12:43-45). The same parable was told in luke 11:24-26.
meditation: Jesus Christ told this parable about a person, who left from his sinning activity and became a person of good character, but not having Holy Spirit in him. In spite of leaving sins and doing good works one cannot get the Holy Spirit in him, because he was a sinner by birth. His heart is only a cleaned house.

Evil Spirits cannot stay where God is there. Evil Spirits left screaming a person and questioned Jesus as said in Mark 1:24, “Are you here to destroy us?”. Evil Spirits search for the dry areas where there is no word of God.

They search for persons who have no Word of God and a place where there is no  Holy Spirit.  The Word of God (Jesus) and the Holy Spirit existed with God. John 1:2 says, “Before the world was created, the Word already existed, he was with God, and he was the same as God”.

Satan enters in humans,  basing on a small bad or unholy thought or act.  Though the evil spirit left the man when it found uncomfortable, when the man decided not to do evil acts, it feels as if it is it’s own house.

Though the man lives a good life without doing evil acts, the evil spirit  gets seven more evils of higher grade and spoils him, unless he has God's fear and God’s word in him. Fear of the Lord and God’s word (scripture) will protect a man from the entry of Evil spirits.

John the disciple of Jesus in his first letter to the early Christian congregations in chapter 4:2-3, clarified that “This is how you will be able to know whether it is God’s spirit: any one who acknowledges that Jesus Christ came as a human being has the spirit, who comes from God. But anyone who denies this about Jesus does not have the spirit from God.”

Jesus Christ is the only Holy person. Those who approach and follow His commandments only can please Him to get the help from the Holy Spirit. Those who believe Jesus, heard him and live righteously following His commands, can lead a successful life in Him in the lighting path of Jesus Christ, since Jesus came to the world as light.

Where there is Christ, there is no place for sin, no place for darkness since Jesus is the light of the world. The word was the source of light, and this light brought light to mankind (John 1:4). Where there is no Christ, the evil spirit enters as self righteousness and spoils that person.
Leaving sin is not enough, live with Jesus.
parables.prayer: -  Our Holy God, we understand that our good works and worldly righteousness cannot protect us from Evil, unless we follow Jesus and the Holy Spirit in us. Help us to live with Jesus.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

parables.title: Parable on new wine and old wine
scripture: Some Pharisees and the leaders of the Law asked Jesus, “Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and other outcasts?”.  Jesus answered them, “People who are well, do not need a doctor, but only those who are sick. I have not come to call respectable people to repent, but outcasts”.
meditation: Some people said to Jesus, “The disciples of John the Baptist fast frequently and offer prayers, and the disciples of the Pharisees do the same, but your disciples eat and drink”. Jesus answered, “Do you think you can make the guests at a wedding party go without food as long as the bridegroom is with them?. Of course not !  But the day will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast”.

Jesus also told them this parable. “No one tears a piece of new coat to patch up an old coat. If he does, he will have torn the new coat and the piece of new coat will not match the old. Nor does any one pour new one into used wineskins, because the new wine will burst the skins, the new wine will pour out, and the skin will be ruined”. Instead new must be poured into fresh wineskins ! And no one wants new wine after drinking old wine, ‘the old is better’ he says.

The same parable was told in Mathews 9:14-17 and in Mark 2:14-22. The Law of the Lord was compared to old wineskins and old wine. People who are accustomed to old wine say that old wine is good. They do not prefer to accept a change. The teachings of Jesus are compared to new wine.

This parable reveals as a prophecy that the then teachers of the Law of the Lord do not accept Jesus as Messiah,  as professized in the law of the Lord, and they do not accept Jesus as Son of God, and that they kill Jesus, and after that only the disciples and the believers of Jesus will fast. It also revealed that those (orthodox) people do not like to accept newness (though professized) from out of the Law of the Lord.

Those Pharisees asked why Jesus and the disciples are eating and drinking with the tax collectors and outcasts. The question revealed the self righteousness and self hiking mentality of the Jews.  Jesus explained that as per God’s plan, he came to this world for the salvation of all people and specially to call back the sinners.

Before that, John the Baptist said (as in Mathews 3:2), “Turn Away from your sins, because the kingdom of Heaven is near”. He also said about Jesus that (in Mathews 3:11), “I baptize you with water to show that you have repented, but the one who will come after me will Baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire. He is much greater than I am”.

The prophet Nehemya prophesied about 500 years before Christ, stating that the Isralites are not repenting about their unholy activities. God commanded Israelites to repent from their sins and turn towards God, and said, “Love the Lord the God, with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your strength.”

Jesus said to follow the same commandment. Not only Isralites, all the people in the world (including gentiles) should follow God's commandments, and come into the purview of God’s salvation plan through faith in Jesus and change themselves from the worldly customs, repent and hold the Holy Spirit and worship God.

While comparing himself as the Son of God as bridegroom, Jesus questioned how the people of the bridegroom can make fasting. But the disciples and the believers of Jesus enjoyed it as if they were with the bridegroom.
Old sinning habits are to be left for a new life with Jesus.
parables.prayer: Our  gracious Father, thank you to provide us with your Holy Spirit after we completely leave our sins and follow Jesus. Help us to lead a new life with Jesus. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

parables.title: Parable of the Sower.
scripture: “Once there was a man who went out to sow corn. As he shattered the seed in the field, some of it fell along the path and the birds came and ate it up. Some of it fell on the rocky ground, where there was little soil. The seeds soon sprouts, because the soil was not deep. But when the sun came up, it burnt the young plant, and because the roots have not gone deep enough, the plants soon dried up.

Some of the seed fell among thorn bushes, which grew up and choked the plants. But some seeds fell in good soil, and the plants produced corn, some produced hundred grains, others sixty and others thirty. And Jesus concluded, “Listen, then, if you have ears” (Mathews 13:3-9).

Jesus again said in 14 and 15 verses, “So the prophecy of Isaiah (6:9) applies to them. ‘The people will listen and listen, but not understand, they will look and look, but not see, because their minds are dull, and they have stopped up their ears and have closed their eyes, otherwise they would see, their ears would hear, their minds would understand, and they would turn to me, says God, and I would heal them’.”

We can see the same in Mathews 13:17. When asked, Jesus explained the meaning of this parable. “listen, then, and learn what the parable of the sower means. Those who hear the message about the kingdom but do not understand it are like the seeds that fall along the path. The Evil comes and snatches away what was sown in them.

The seeds that fell on the rocky ground stand for those  who receive the message gladly as soon as they hear it.  But it doesn't sink deep  into them, and they dont last long. So when trouble or persecution comes  because of the message, they give up at once.

The seeds that fell among other bushes stand for those who hear the message; but the worries about his life and the love for riches choke the message, and they don’t bear fruit. And the seeds sown in the good soil stand for those who hear the message and understand it, they bear fruit, some as much as a hundred, others sixty and others thirty.” (Mathews 13:18-23)

The life of Jesus Christ was full of prophecy. It is God’s plan. It was meant to save us from our sins and keep us in his presence as Holy. The teachers of the Law of the Lord are aware of the prophecies on the coming of the Messiah and they are waiting for the Messiah. But they could not understand that Jesus was the Messiah.  They are expecting Messiah as king.

Some disciples and followers understand that Jesus was the Messiah and they followed Jesus. They could see the miracles done by Jesus with their own eyes. But the disciples could not understand about the kingdom of Heaven. Therefore Jesus explained the meaning of the parables also to them.

Nowadays the Word of God is being proclaimed in house prayers, in churches, special meetings (crusades), in radios and  televisions, in papers (pamphlets), in books, in cell phones etc.. This is what the sowing of the Word of God means.
meditation: The sown Word of God needs to be meditated. If the Word of God is not meditated, it resembles the seed falling on the roadside and birds will take away the seed. so much so Satan will take away that word from us. Thus there is no possibility for germination.

Some seeds fell on rocky soil. They quickly germinate. In the meanwhile, Satan creates doubts in our minds, creates unfaithfulness and weakens our faith, so that the word will get dried up and become weak and unfruitful.

Some seeds fell in thorny bushes. Though we meditate and make the word germinate, worldly attractions and worldly troubles suppress the word in our minds, mislead us or divert us from the word of God, and suppress growth in our lives. Such suppressions would not allow the word of God to grow in us and thus make it unfruitful.

If we meditate on the Word of God, understand the same, keep faith and hope in Jesus, it will grow healthy, like the seed sown in good soil which ultimately will be fruitful hundred times, sixty times and thirty times, by the Grace of God.

Psalms 1 says that,  happy are those who study and in obeying the Law of the Lord, day and night and they find joy. They grow like trees that grow besides a stream, that bear fruit at the right time, they succeed in everything they do.

Listening, meditating and obeying the Law of the Lord, is in our hands only. If we live according to the word of God, we can enjoy spiritual fruit in us. Galatians 5:22 says about the Spiritual fruit as, “love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, humility and self control”. Those yielding spiritual fruit will be blessed to get spiritual protection.
God likes people who hear, meditate and live according to His Word.
parables.prayer: Our Holy God,  thank you for the eternal plan to bring us back to your fold through Jesus. Help us to follow Jesus, follow your Word through the Holy Spirit, and to be fruitful like a seed that was sown in good soil. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

parables.title: Parable of the weeds.
scripture: “The kingdom of heaven is like this. A man sowed good seed in  his field. One night when everyone was asleep, an enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat and went away. When the plants grew and the ears of corn began to form, then the weeds showed up. The man’s servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, it was a good seed you sowed in your field; where did the weeds come from?’. ‘It was some enemy who did this’ he answered.

‘Do you want us to go and pull up the weeds’?, they asked him. ‘No’ he answered, because as you gather the weeds you might pull some of the wheat along with them. Let the wheat and the weeds grow together until harvest. Then I will tell the harvest workers to pull up the weeds first, tie them in bundles and burn them, and then to gather the wheat and put it in my barn”.

At the time of the day of judgment, how the good people and the bad people get separated, was explained by Jesus in this parable. The earth is compared to his field. Man and woman are compared as seeds sown by him. At the time of their creation they are found good, without any sin. God saw everything created  was good. After blessing everything he created, he stopped working on the seventh day and took rest.

It indicates that God waited for the creation to be fruitful. At that time, Satan sowed weeds. Satan entered Eden garden and created certain doubts in the minds of Adam and Eve, which resulted in flouting the command of God. Flouting the commandments of God is a sin. Satan is an enemy to God. That sin is told as weeds.
At the time of fruiting, a good seed will give a good yield of wheat. Spiritual fruits are compared as good fruit. Worldly fruits are compared as fruits of sin ie., weeds.
meditation: Plucking of weeds means destroying sinful activities or sinning persons. Servants or harvesting workers means Angels of God. “As you gather the weeds you might pull some of the wheat along with them” gives a meaning that there is a possibility that good grain may get damaged or destroyed while removing the unwanted weeds. He doesn't like to see any good grain get damaged or destroyed. This shows how God loved mankind (whether they are  in faith or not), and the long suffering he had, to restore the unfaithful persons towards him.

“God loved the world so much”. He doesn’t want to lose anybody for their sins. Being Holy, he is prepared to bear all the sins of the people who believe him, and restore them to be Holy. He showed long suffering for restoration of souls. He himself bore all the sins of people, paid ransom for the sins on the cross, died and resurrected as Holy. He is waiting for the restoration of the souls of mankind as Holy towards Him.

Day of harvesting in  this parable means the day of judgment. God will decide that day. On that day he will throw the evil persons (ie., weeds) into hell, and collect  all the good souls or restored souls into heaven. Those who realize that the soul is the gift of God and produces good fruits as per His will, will be blessed to be in the  presence of God.
God shows patience towards unfruitful persons, to ensure safety of the fruitful persons.
parables.prayer: Our gracious Father, thank you for the eternal plan to save our souls, and for your love and long suffering towards us. Help us to lead a life of good fruits.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

parables.title: Parable of Kingdom of Heaven
scripture: John the Baptist started preaching, “turn away from your sins, because the kingdom of heaven is near”. Jesus said in Mathews 10:7 that the kingdom of heaven is near. Jesus revealed the kingdom of heaven  in several parables.

(a)  “The kingdom of heaven is like this. A man takes a mustard seed and sows it in his field. It is the smallest of all the seeds, but when it grows up, it is the biggest of all plants. It becomes a tree, so that  birds come and make their nests in its branches”, Jesus said this as a parable in Matthew 13:31-32. Same parable was written in Mark 4:30-32 and in Luke 13:18-19.

This parable indicates that when the word of God is fruitful in us, it will be a blessing for many people. God sowed the seed.  Seed is indicated as Jesus. The seed after it is buried (or died) it germinates, grows with leaves and branches and becomes a big tree.

It  resembled in Jesus for the death (burial), resurrection and  grew with a small number of disciples who established  churches and spread christianity all over the world with the Gospel. Different races and nations in the world represent the varieties of birds to live on the big tree, and represent the followers of Christ irrespective of race and nations.

(b) Another parable on the kingdom of heaven says like this.“The kingdom of heaven is like this. A woman takes some yeast and mixes it with forty liters of flour until the whole batch of dough rises''. This is said in Mathew 13:33 and also in Luke 20:2. Here how  the word of God, so small in quantum, is spreading throughout the world. It is one angle.
meditation: In another angle, yeast is compared as worldly customs, stupid arguments, false teachings etc., that may develop in the faithful congregations of Jesus in the world. Those things spoil the faithful people and lead them to unfaithfulness. Guard yourself from  the yeast of the Pharisees and sadducees. Jesus said on another occasion in Mathews 16:12.

It was professized to be conscious and beware of such false teachings. This is looking like the parable of “blind lead the blind”. Jesus professized and warned us to be careful about the false teachings.

(c) Another parable says, “The kingdom of heaven is like this man. A man happens to find a treasure hidden in a field. He covers it up again, and is so happy that he goes and sells everything he has, and then goes back and buys that field”. (Matthew 13:44).

In order to get the treasure hidden in a field, one prepares himself to sell away all his properties, pool up all his money and buy the field. Heaven happens to be the most valued treasure than anything else. Everyone desires to be in heaven after death. Everyone has to strive hard to be in heaven, since life on earth is not permanent.

The Devil proposed to Jesus to worship him, so that he would hand over all the kingdoms of the world ie., treasures to Jesus. Jesus answered, `Worship your Lord and God and serve only Him.’ Jesus stood as an example to reject the proposal of the Devil. All the kingdoms of the world are not permanent.
Jesus confirmed the happiness in heaven in providing salvation to the  lost spirits of worldly people. Jesus said, “the angels of God rejoice over one sinner who repents”. (Luke 15:10).

(d) Another parable says, “The kingdom of heaven is like this. A man is looking for fine pearls. When he finds one that is unusually fine, he goes and sells everything he has and buys that pearl”. It is said in  Mathew 13:45-46.

God found the human race as unusually fine pearls. God made man in his likeness. When the man on earth became a slave to the sin and lost his Holy Spirit, God himself leaving heaven came to the earth and born as a human, made himself as a sacrifice to restore the human race.

(e) Another parable says, “The kingdom of heaven is like this. Some fishermen throw their net out in the lake and catch all kinds of fish. When the net is full, they pull it to shore and sit down to divide the fish: the good ones go into their baskets and the worthless ones are thrown away.

It will be like this at the end of the age: the angels will go out and gather up the evil people from among the good and will throw them into the fiery furnace; where they will cry and grind their teeth. (Mathew 13:47-50). “When the net is full” means “when the day of judgment comes”.

Spiritually good people are compared as good fish, and the unspiritual people or worldly people are compared as worthless fish. It is found that spiritual people and unspiritual people will be segregated at the time of God’s judgment.

The day of judgment was not revealed to anybody. Therefore while we are living in this world only, we are expected to rectify ourselves and live according to the Word of God so that we can get into heaven.

(f) Another parable says, “Every teacher of the Law who becomes a disciple in the kingdom of heaven is like the owner of a house who takes new and old things out of his storeroom.” (Mathew 13:52). Newness and development ie., fruitfulness is compared to new things. Unuseful old things (worthless things) are compared as  old things which need to be left out. The owner of the house allows entry of newness and development or improvements into his house and rejects the old unuseful things, which are not useful as per the Law of the Lord.

(g) Another parable says, “The kingdom of God is like this. A man scatters seed in his field. He sleeps at night, is up and about during the day, and all the while the seeds are sprouting and growing.  Yet he doesn’t know how it happens. The soil itself makes the plants grow and bear fruit; first the tender stalk appears, then the ear, and finally the ear full of corn. When the corn is ripe, the man starts cutting it with his sickle, because harvest time has come”, Jesus said in Mark 4:26-29.

“Sleeping at night and waking up during the day” gives a meaning that growth is allowed without His interference. “The soil itself makes the plants grow and bear fruit” means that every creation does its duty as a routine way as a normal growth. When the time for harvest has come, ie., when the time fixed for judgment comes, God uses all the development (fruitful condition) for his glory.

Man is compared as a sown seed. After creating man, God blessed and said, “Have many children, so that your descendants will live all over the earth and bring it under their control”. God created all kinds of grain and all kinds of fruits, animals and birds and fish. It was all God’s plan, to allow the fruit bearing trees and also the weeds, and finally  closes his plan at the time of judgment.
Earth did its entrusted duty, while God observed the man, as to whether he bears the right fruits or weeds. He sends the people either to heaven or to hell,  at the time of judgment.

God left everything to the discretion of man, as to whether he bears good fruits or bad fruits in his lifetime. God gave full freedom to man to use his mind for good works or bad works. It is for man to make use of the opportunity of the freedom given by God, which  sends it to his destination, ie., heaven or hell.

Human body is created from the earth and it has to go to earth after death. God gave spirit. Spirit has to be handed over to God. Jesus himself handed over his spirit to the Father, the God. Man is a sinner by birth, but he has to be reborn with the Holy Spirit and keep his spirit as Holy till his death  to reach God.

Fruiting and developing through the word of God, keeping away from foolish arguments and rejecting unholy, searching for salvation of the lost by spreading the Gospel, reborn with the Holy Spirit and seeking eternal bliss,   are the aspects Jesus revealed in these parables.
parables.prayer: Our heavenly Father, we understand that you gave us a chance to prove ourselves to lead a good and meaningful life, so that our destination will be in your presence in Heaven. Help us to achieve our goal. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

parables.title: Parable of Blind leading Blind
scripture: “One blind man cannot lead another one, if he does, both will fall into a ditch. No pupil is greater than the teacher; but every pupil, when he has completed his training, will be like his teacher. Why do you look at the speck in your brother’s eye? How can you say to your brother, ‘Please, brother, let me take out that speck out of your eye, yet cannot see the log in your own eye? You hypocrite ! first take the log out of your own eye, and then you will be able to see clearly to take the speck out of your brother's eye”, said Jesus in Luke 6:39-49.

“A healthy tree does not bear bad fruit, nor does a poor tree bear good fruit. Every tree is known by the fruit it bears; you do not pick figs from  thorn bushes or gather grapes from bramble bushes. A good person brings good  out of the treasure of good things in his heart, a bad person brings bad out of his treasure of bad things. For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.” (Luke 6:43-45).

Jesus spoke to the Pharisees and Teachers of the Law, “You hypocrites, “How right Isaiah was, when he prophesied about you.” These people say God, honor me with their words, but their heart is really far away from me. It is no use for them to worship me, because they teach man-made rules as though they were my laws”. (Isaiah 29:13).
meditation: “Then Jesus called the crowd to him and said to them ‘Listen and understand, it is not what goes into a person's mouth that makes him ritually unclean; rather what comes out of it makes him unclean”. Jesus continued, ”Every plant which my Father in Heaven did not plant will be pulled up.

Don't worry about the Pharisees and teachers of the Law. They are blind leaders of the blind; and when one blind man leads another, both fall into a ditch. Anything  that goes into a person’s mouth goes into his stomach and then out of his body. But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart, and these are the things that make a person ritually unclean.

For, from  his heart come the evil ideas, which lead him to kill, commit adultery, and do other immoral things; to rob, lie, and slender others. But to eat without washing your hands as they say you should -- this doesn’t make a person unclean.” (Mathew 15:7-20).

A man gets unclean from the evil ideas, killing, committing adultery, and immoral things like robbing and slandering others, comes from his own heart. God created man in his likeness to see his Holiness  and to see him  live Holy. Worldly people considered unclean and unholy persons as gods and their incarnation. Holiness needs to come out of the heart, but not by physical cleanliness of

hands or legs or by washing by water etc,. Words come out of a mouth that have the basis of what they have in their heart. An unholy person speaks of unholy words, and does unholy acts. Good words will not come from such persons, and do not yield good fruits  ie.,  good results.

Some teachers teach man-made customs as Laws of the Lord, they are all hypocrites. They teach with their mouth but their hearts are away from God. Jesus categorically told this about those teachers of God’s Law. Since they did not understand God's Laws but they preached man-made customs as God’s Laws.

God said, “respect your father and your mother’, and whoever curses his father or mother is to be put to death’.  But you teach that if a person has something he could use to help his father or mother, but says, “This belongs to God, he does not need to honor his father. And in  this way you disregard God’s command, in order to follow your own teaching”.

Keep the Sabbath as Holy and honor the place where you worship God. But the teachers of the Law made a custom that nobody should work on a sabbath day, and objected to life saving acts or good acts also, and thus introduced wrong customs and misled the people. They became blind and leading blind people.

In the present day worship also, many are doing unwanted worship. They don't remove the stack in their eye and without understanding  their blindness, they are misleading people into the wrong customs. They not only fall into the wrong pits but lead their followers to the same trouble. It is a lesson for the Christians to be aware of misleading preachings on customs, and to be careful about such wrong preachings.
Any preaching which is not based on the Word of God and any act that does not bring glory to God is a misleading preaching.
Beware of the wrong teachings misleading men.
parables.prayer: Our merciful Father, protect us from the misleading preachings which are based on worldly customs, and give us a discerning spirit to keep away from such preachings, and to lead life acceptable to you.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

parables.title: Parable of the unforgiving Servant
scripture: “Peter came to Jesus and asked, ‘Lord, if my brother keeps on sinning against me, how many times do I have to forgive him? Seven times?. ‘No. Not seven times’ answered Jesus, ‘seventy seven times, because the kingdom of heaven is like this. Then Jesus said this parable.

Once there was a king who decided to check on his servant’s accounts. He had just begun to do so when one of them was brought in who owed him millions of pounds. The servant did not have enough to pay his debts, so the king ordered him to be sold as a slave, with his wife and his children and all that he had, in order to pay the debt.
The servant fell to his knees before the king, ‘Be patient with me’, he begged, ‘and I will pay you everything’. The king felt sorry on his servant, so he forgave him and let him go”.

“Then the man went out and met one of his fellow servants who owed him a  few pounds. He grabbed and started choking him. ‘Pay back what you owe me,’ he said. His fellow servant fell down and begged him. ‘Be patient with me, and I will pay you back’. But he refused, instead, he had him thrown into jail until he could pay his debt.

When the other servants saw what had happened, they were very upset and went to the king and told him everything.  So he called the servant in. ‘You worthless slave’, he said, ‘I forgave the whole amount you owed me, just because you asked me to. You should have had mercy on your fellow-servant, just as I had mercy on you.

The king was very angry, and he sent the servant to jail to be punished until he should pay back the whole amount. And Jesus concluded, “That is how my Father in heaven will treat everyone of you unless you forgive your brother from your heart.”
meditation: Jesus taught us how we should pray to God. One part of the prayer in Matthews 6:12, says, ‘Forgive us the wrongs we have done as we forgive the wrongs that others have done to us’. Wrongs include not only debt but also  who got any benefit, by a word or action, but not repaid or ungrateful persons.
God gave us the body and soul, and also all the wealth and family also. We should always remember that all life is given by God and we should be very thankful to God every day.

We all pray God confessing our sins to forgive and excuse. We are also bound to forgive and excuse our fellow-men about the wrongs they have done for us. Mathews 7:1-2 says, “Do not judge others, so that God will not judge you, for God will judge you in the same way as you judge others, and he will apply to you the same rules you apply to others”.
In fact, we may be excusing our fellow-men many times, but it will not count much when compared to God's excuses for us.

All persons are sinners by birth itself. Jesus forgives our sins. He forgave sins and thereby  people were healed while they were sick on account of their sin.  We have to change our hearts with truthfulness to get forgiveness of our sins, then God will forgive us.

Mathews 18:15 says, “If your brother sins against you, go to him and show him his fault. But do it privately, just between yourselves. If he listens to you, you have won your brother back”. Unless we leave our sinning thoughts and actions, and pray to God to forgive us, there is no forgiveness for our sins.

Mathew 5:44 says, ”Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you, so that you may become sons of your Father in heaven.” People who cannot forgive cannot love. Unless we cannot forgive our neighbor or anybody who commits sin against us, we cannot say that we are loving anybody.

While suffering on the cross, on behalf of those who crucified him, Jesus prayed to God, “Forgive them Father, They don’t know what they are doing”, (Luke 23:34). While teaching us to pray for those who sin against us, Jesus himself prayed for those who crucified him, and became a model for us.
God will not forgive us, unless we forgive our fellow men.
parables.prayer: Our merciful Father, we understand that you judge us the same way we judge others, and we cannot get forgiveness unless we forgive our fellowmen. Help us to show  your love towards our enemies. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

parables.title: Parable on the workers in the vineyard
scripture: Jesus said, “The kingdom of heaven is like this. Once there was a man who went out early in the morning to hire some men to work in his vineyard. He agreed to pay them the regular wage, a silver coin a day,  and sent them to work in his vineyard. He went out again to the marketplace at nine O‘clock and saw some men standing there doing nothing. So he told them, ‘you also go and work in the vineyard and I will pay you a fair wage’. So they went.

Then at twelve O’clock he did the same thing. It was nearly five O’clock, when he went to the market place and saw other men still standing there. ‘Why are you wasting the whole day here doing nothing?’, he asked them  ‘No one hired us, they answered. ‘Well then, you also go and work in the vineyard’, he told them.

“When evening came, the owner told his foreman, ‘Call the workers and pay them wages, starting with those who were hired last and ending with those who were hired first’. The men who had begun to work at five O’clock were paid a silver coin each. So when the men who were the first to be hired came to be paid, they thought they would get more; but they too were given a silver coin each.

They took their money and started grumbling against the employer. ‘Those men who were hired last worked only one hour’, they said, ‘while we were put up with a whole day’s work in the hot sun - yet you paid them the same as you paid us’. ‘Listen friend, the owner answered one of them, ‘I have not cheated you. After all, you agreed to do a day’s work for one silver coin. Now take your pay and go home.

I want to give this man who was hired last as much as I have given you. Don't I have the right to do as I wish with my own money?  Or, are you jealous because I'm generous?” So Jesus concluded, ‘So those who are last will be first,  and those who are first will be last’.
meditation: In this parable, the owner of the house is God, workers are people on earth, vineyard can be compared as earth. All people are sent to earth at different times as per His Plan. We are all pots made by the pot-maker, God.

There is no written Law of the Lord, to the people prior to Moses. They lived as per the oral command of God. God commanded Adam and Eve orally, not to eat the forbidden fruit in the Eden Garden. God said to Cain, “if you had done the right thing you would be smiling, but because you have done evil, sin is crouching at your door. It wants to rule you, but you must overcome it”. (Genesis 4:7). It was God’s command, not to think of evil thoughts or not to do evil  things, but to overcome the sinning habit.

After the Law of the Lord was revealed and written, people are commanded to live as per Law. The people who lived after Jesus are commanded to keep faith in Jesus and live according to the commands of Jesus.

A teacher of the Law of the Lord questioned what I must do to receive eternal life. Jesus questioned him as to what the scripture says about it. He answered, “Love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind” and “Love your neighbor as you love yourself”.

“You are right” Jesus replied,  “do this and you will live”. (Luke 10:27-28). This command was said in the old testament (Leviticus 19-18). Jesus said the same command in Mathews 19:19 and in Mark 12:30-31.

The late arrived people like us have plenty of opportunities to know about God. We are like workers called in the last hour to work in the God’s vineyard. Not like the workers sent to the vineyard in the first hour, we, the last hour workers, are also made eligible to get salvation by the grace of God. This is only by grace of God not as a privilege.

By the grace of God only, without our offerings in lieu of our sins, we are privileged to be in salvation through Jesus Christ. Therefore we are not supposed to question the variations of God given gifts in this life. Such questioning is the consequence of Jealousy, which is an unwanted bad fruit from our mind.
Variations on the free gifts of God are unquestionable.  Leave greediness and jealousy.
parables.prayer: Our gracious Father, We thank you for your plan to provide salvation to all mankind, at different timings and with different gifts. We understand that we are to lead our life with satisfaction of whatever gifts we are provided. We know that greediness and jealousy will take us far from your mercy. Help us to live that pleases you. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

parables.title: Parable of two sons.
scripture: Jesus said, “There was once a man who had two sons. He went to the elder one and said, ‘Son, go and work in the vineyard today’. ‘I don’t want to’, he answered, but later he changed his mind and went. Then the father went to the other son and said the same thing. ‘Yes Sir’, he answered, but he did not go. Which one of the two did what his father wanted?” “The elder one” they answered. They are the Chief Priest and the elders of the temple.

So Jesus said to them.  “I tell you, the tax collectors and the prostitutes are going into the kingdom of God ahead of you. For John the Baptist came to you showing you the right path to take, and you would not believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. Even when you saw this,  you did not later change your minds and believe him”. (Mathews 21:28-32).
meditation: John the Baptist was a messenger of God, having the spirit of Prophet Elijah. He came to prepare a way for Jesus. The people who heard him and  believed in him, leaving their sins and repenting and taking Baptism.

Tax payers and prostitutes means people who are dwelling in sins including gentiles. They do not know about God. They are like the elder son, who instantly rejects to receive any call from God. Israelites are compared as the other son, who knows about God and instantly accepts the law of the Lord. Jesus came as Messiah to restore salvation to the last people of Israelites and also salvation to the gentiles.

In this parable, the first son instantly declined to follow the command of his father, but changed his mind and went to the vineyard, while the second one readily accepted the command of his father, but he did not go. People who did as per the command of God is only eligible to enter heaven.

The first one may be a sinner by initially declining the command of God, but he did as per the command and got eligibility to enter into Heaven. The second one readily accepted orally by words, but acted against his own words. God likes actions (implementations), but not hearing and accepting them by words.

What we have to learn from this parable is, it is not enough if we read the Bible, hear the word of God, sing or worship, or publish a word of God by pamphlet, book or praise the Lord, but live in reality as per commands of Jesus. God likes  such people.
Doing is more important than telling.
parables.prayer: Our merciful Father, thank you Father for showing long suffering for our salvation, waiting and waiting for a change in our attitudes. Help us to be doers rather than simply listeners. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

parables.title: Parable of tenants in the vineyard
scripture: “There was once a landowner who planted a vineyard, put a fence around it, dug a hole for the winepress, and built a watch tower. Then he let out the vineyard to tenants and went on a journey. When the time came to gather the grapes, he sent his slaves to the tenants to receive his share of the harvest. The tenants seized his slaves, beat one, killed another and stoned another.

Again the man sent other slaves, more than the first time, and the tenants treated them the same way. Last of all, he sent his son to them,  ‘surely they will respect my son,’ he said. But when the tenants saw the son, they said to themselves, ‘This is the owner’s son. Come on. Let’s kill him and we will get his property’. So they seized him, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.

Now, when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants, Jesus asked. ‘He will certainly kill those evil men’, they answered, ‘and let the vineyard out to other tenants, who will give him his share of the harvest at the right time’.

Jesus said to them, ‘Haven't ever read what the scripture says? ‘The stone which the builders rejected as worthless turned out to be the  most important of all. This was done by the Lord, what a wonderful sight it is?’. “And so I tell you,'' added Jesus, “the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce proper fruits.” The same parable was told  in Mathews 21:33-43,   Mark 12:1-12, and in Luke 20:9-18.
meditation: In this parable, the owner of the vineyard is God. Putting a fence, digging a hole for a winepress, building a watch-tower etc., indicating his creation in completeness, and looking at it, as good. God created everything that is needed by man, and to help for his  development.

The tenants are representing the chosen Isralites for God's plan. The slaves are representing the Prophets who are sent by him. The prophets were beaten and injured, some were killed. Other tenants represent the gentiles.

Jesus Christ was sent as His son. In this parable, the Son of God, Jesus Christ was sent to this earth to  restore God’s glory by saving all the people, by his crucifiction and resurrection after death, salvation to gentiles by faith. Jesus prophesied about his death in this parable.
The scripture quoted by Jesus was written in Psalms 118:22-23. God’s plan for salvation to gentiles by faith was revealed by Jesus Christ.

In another parable (Luke 13:6-9), Jesus warned that everybody (Isralite or gentile) should be fruitful in their life and if anybody does not give good fruit, they (that tree) will be cut off from God's plan.
In this parable, Jesus revealed himself as the Son of God and professized that he is going to be killed.
God’s plan is about the salvation of the lost souls ie., lost Israelites and gentiles.
parables.prayer: Our Father in heaven, we understand your plan to save all mankind, that is Isralites and gentiles as well. Help us to be fruitful in our lives, that pleases you. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

parables.title: The parable of the wedding feast.
scripture: “Once there was a king who prepared a wedding feast for his son. He sent his servants to tell the invited guests to come to the feast, but they did not want to come. So he sent other servants with this message for the guests: ‘My feast is ready now; my bullocks and prize calves have been butchered, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding feast’.

But the invited guests paid no attention and went about their businesses:  one went to his farm, another to his shop, while others grabbed the servants, beat them, and killed them. The king was very angry; so he sent his soldiers, who killed those murderers and burnt down their city.

Then he called his servants and said to them, ‘My wedding feast is ready, but the people I invited did not deserve it. Now go to the  main streets and invite as many people to the feast as you find’. So the servants went out to the streets and gathered all the people they could find, good and bad alike, and the wedding hall was filled with people.

“The king went in to look at the guests and saw a man who was not wearing wedding clothes. ‘Friend, how did you get in here without wedding clothes?,’ the king asked him. But the man said nothing. Then the king told the servants, ‘tie him up hand and foot, and throw him outside the dark. There he will cry and grind his teeth’. And Jesus concluded, ‘Many are invited, but few are chosen’. (Mathews 22:1-14)
meditation: Feast is indicated as Heaven, arranged by God. Invited people are Isralites, the chosen people of God. Jesus said in Mathews 15:24, “I have been sent only to the lost sheep of the people of Israel'. In Mathews 10:6, Jesus directed his disciples, ‘Do not go to any gentile territory or any Samaritan towns. Instead you are to go to the last sheep of Israel. Go and preach that the kingdom of heaven is near’.

But many of the  people of Israel neglected God. But they focused their interest on earthly affairs, which are not permanent and showed a deaf ear on the call of God. Moreover they insulted prophets and killed them. The servants in the parable are compared as prophets. The killing of those who killed the prophets, and burning their city represents the second coming of Jesus.

All are invited for the feast. That means, not only Isralites but also all gentiles are called for. Those who heard about Jesus, who paid attention to the call of salvation, and believers, whether good or bad, are all invited. “Because God so loved the world”..., all gentiles like ours, are called on by the grace of God.

One of the invitees has no wedding clothes. The king saw him and said, ‘Friend, how could you come without wedding clothes?  Wedding clothes indicate preparedness and whole-hearted willingness to enter the feast, ie., God’s eternal plan for salvation. He had no answer and hence kept quiet. Keeping quiet is an indication of admitting guiltiness.

If that person admits his fault honestly and prays for forgiveness, he would have been forgiven and allowed to enjoy the feast, after providing the wedding clothes. Jesus is ready at the door knocking for our salvation. If that person prayed for forgiveness, he would not have faced the situation of throwing into darkness.

Wedding clothes indicate preparedness in spirit. Heaven is compared to a wedding feast. It is Holy. We are supposed to enter heaven as a holy being. The king addressed the person (without faith and with unholy spirit) as ‘friend’. This indicates how God loves us and the way he treats us to rectify ourselves.

Luke 3:3 says, ‘Turn away from your sins and be baptized, and God will forgive your sins’. Mark 16:16 says, ‘Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved; and whoever does not believe will be condemned’. Turning away from sins and openly accepting Jesus for salvation is the indication of marriage clothes in this parable.

God knows our thoughts and all secrets in our hearts. We are to repent for our sins, leave the sins and pray to God for forgiveness and undergo baptism.  Forgiveness is indicated as wedding clothes in this parable. In the parable of ‘the lost son’, when the lost son repented for his sins and started to come back to his father, the father himself came forward and met his son and invited him to join. We can see the same love of God, if we leave our sins and repent.

John the Baptist said that he is baptizing in water only, but Jesus ‘is the one who baptizes with holy spirit’. (Luke 1:31 & 33). One of the thieves crucified along with Jesus, believed in Jesus as son of God, repented on his sins and asked (ie.,prayed to) Jesus, while on cross, ‘Remember me Jesus, when you come as king’. Jesus said to him, ‘I promise you today, you will be in paradise with me’. (Luke 23:42-43).

In the special circumstance of hanging on the cross, there is no possibility of taking water baptism, but Jesus is holy (who baptizes in water and in the Holy Spirit),  assured him of salvation to the thief on the spot. It doesn’t mean that Baptism is a formality. Faith and repentance has to precede Baptism. Jesus (though Holy) and sinless, he himself took Baptism through John the Baptist, as a model for us.

Believing in Jesus, confessing and leaving sins, taking an oath before Holy Spirit and men while baptizing, living as his beloved people as per his commandments, makes us eligible to His grace enter into heaven, which is indicated as marriage clothes in this parable.
Though called on to repent while in sin, entry into the kingdom of heaven can only be after turning away from sins.
parables.prayer: Our heavenly Father, thank you for the grace you showed to us to provide salvation through faith in Jesus and following his commandments, after repentance and leaving  our unfruitful, sinful acts and openly taking part as a true christian.  Help us to live a life that pleases you. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

parables.title: Parable of fig tree - Second coming of the Son of God -
scripture: well prepared servant.

“Let the fig tree teach you a lesson. When the branches become green and tender and it starts putting out leaves, you know that summer is near. In the same way, when you see all these things, you will know that the time is near, ready to begin. Remember that all these things will happen before the people now living have all died. Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.

“No one knows however when that day and hour will come --  neither the angels in heaven nor the Son; the Father alone knows. The coming of the Son of Man will be like what happened in the time of Novah. In the days before the flood, people ate and drank, men and women married, upto the very day Noah entered into the boat, yet they did not realize what was happening when the flood came and swept them all away”.

“That is how it will be when the son of man comes. At that time two men will be working in the field; one will be taken away and the other will be left behind.  Two women will be at a mill grinding meal, one will be taken away, and the other will be left behind”.
meditation: “Be on your guard, then, because you do not know what day your Lord will come. If the owner of the house knows the time when the thief would come, you can be sure that he would stay awake and not let the thief break into his house. So then, you also must already be ready, because the Son of Man will come, at an hour when you are not expecting him”.

“Who then, is a faithful and wise servant? He is the one that his master has placed in charge of the other servants to give them their food at the proper time. How happy that servant is, if his master finds him doing this when he comes home. Indeed, I tell you, the master will put that servant incharge of all his property”.

“But if he is a bad servant, he will tell himself that his master will not be back for a long time, and he will begin to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards. Then that servant’s master will come back one day when the servant does not expect him and at a time he does not know. The master will cut him in pieces and make him share the fate of the hypocrites. There he will cry and grind his teeth”. (Mathews 24:32-51).
It is one of several parables where Jesus told about the second coming of the Son of Man. Before that, the disciples asked Jesus to reveal about his second coming and also about rapture.

“Be on your guard, and do not let anyone deceive you. Many men, claiming to speak for me, will come and say, ‘I am the Messiah’, and they will deceive many people. You are going to hear the noise close by and news of battles far away; but do not be troubled. Such things must happen, but they do not mean that the end has come”. ‘Countries will fight each other, kingdoms will attack one another. There will be famines and earthquakes everywhere. …… Many will give up their faith at that time, they will betray one another and hate one another. …… But whoever holds out  to the end will be saved’.

Matthew 24:29-31 says, ‘Soon after the trouble of those days, the sun will grow dark, the moon will no longer shine, the stars will fall from heaven, and the powers in space will be driven from their courses. Then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky; …. they see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory”.

‘The great trump will sound, and he will send out his angels to the four corners of the earth, and they will gather his chosen people from one end of the  world to the other’. All these things are written in Matthew  24:29-31.

All the above, Jesus told about his second coming and the end of the world. Countries fighting each other, kingdoms against one another, earthquakes, etc., arrival of false christs, Christians get torched  by the worldly people. Because no one knows about the end of the world, all are advised to be alert, be courageous, live honestly following the commandments of God, and firmly with faith and righteousness.
Since all bodily activities will stop from that moment, Jesus commanded us to keep our goal to reach our spirit to God and till then to live cautiously with hope and holiness.
Be on guard and wait for the second coming of the Son of God.
parables.prayer: Our  heavenly Father, thank you for revealing us as to what things will happen before rapture and how consciously we are to prepare ourselves to face rapture despite misleading and false temptations even to the chosen people. Help us to be in your fold till our last breath.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

parables.title: Parable on the Good Samaritan
scripture: There was once a man who was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, when robbers attacked him, stripped him and beat him up, leaving him half dead.  It so happened that a priest was going down that road, but when he saw the man, he walked on by the other side. In the same way a leviet also came along, went over and looked at the man, and then walked on by on the other side.

But a Samaritan who was traveling that way came upon the man and when he saw him,  his heart was filled with pity. He went over to him, poured oil and wine on his wounds and bandaged them, then he put the man on his own animal and took him to an inn, where he took care of him.
The next day he took out two silver coins and gave them to the innkeeper., “Take care of him”,  he told the innkeeper,  “and when I come back this way, I will pay you whatever else you spend on him”.

And Jesus concluded, “In your opinion, which one of these three acted like a neighbor towards the man attacked by the robbers?. The teacher of the Law answered, “the one who was kind to him”. Jesus replied,  "You go, then, and do the same “.
meditation: “Love your neighbor as you love yourself” is the answer of a teacher of the law. “You are right”, Jesus replied, “do this and you will live”. When the Teacher of the Law asked Jesus, Jesus told this parable to him.

It is not written in the bible as to know the  race or caste of the person who was robbed and beaten, while on his way from Jerusalem to Jericho. But one was  a Priest and the other was Leviet who saw the wounded man, but walked on by the other side.

‘Melchizedek’, who was king of Salem, was called the priest of the Most High God in the Bible. Next was Aaron and his family from Isralites. Their duty was to assist the priests in the worship in the synagogues. The priests and Levites are to perform the rituals of the Isralites and be the part of  worship in the temple of the Most High God.

During the days of Jesus Christ, the priests and Leviets became corrupt and misled the public in their own interests and businesses, misinterpreting God's Laws. Jesus highlighted the escaping nature of the priests and Leviets who are supposed to love neighbors as themselves and lead the worship in temples and be a model to the public.

They are selected by God and separated from the rest of the people as His own people for his purpose.  But here a samaritan, a gentile, showed mercy on the  wounded person and his goodness was mentioned.
The Samaritan did not mind who the person wounded, whether belonged to his tribe or the other. He saw him as a neighbor and helped him when he was in trouble. God likes such activities.

Having been in the knowledge and work of God’s temple, the priest and Leviet skipped away from that area, where they are expected to extend their help to the wounded.  Jesus told this parable keeping in mind those who do not extend their helping hand when the public are in trouble and need some help.  Such people cannot love their neighbor. They are inhuman.

Jesus said that the Son of Man comes as a king and says that,  “I was hungry and you fed me, thirsty and you gave me a drink. I was a stranger and you received me  in your home, naked and you clothed me, I was sick and you took care of me, in prison and you visited me". This was  said in Mathews 25:35-36.

Then the righteous answered as to when they did all that. The king will reply, “I tell you whenever you did this  for one of the least important of these brothers of mine, you did it for me,”said Jesus.

The person wounded in this parable is wounded and sick, in hunger and thirsty and in panic, and in that stage, the Samaritan took care of him and comforted. Jesus said that this help one to the wounded person was done to him and therefore the helped Samaritan was praised as Good Samaritan.
“In the same way, your light might shine before people, so that they will see the good things you do and praise your Father in Heaven ‘, said Jesus in Mathews 5:16.
“1 John 4:12 ays, “ If we love one another, God  lives in union with us”. 1 John 4:8 says “whoever does not love does not know God, for God is love”.
parables.prayer: Our loving Father, teach us to show our love to our neighbor so that we can live like beloved children of yours.  We pray for such  understanding in us,  in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

parables.title: Parable of the ten girls - Advance preparation
scripture: “Once there were ten girls who took their oil lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom. Five of them were foolish, and the other five were wise. The foolish ones took their lamps, but did not take any extra oil with them, while the wise ones took containers full of oil for their lamps.  The bridegroom was late in coming,  so the girls began to nod and fall asleep.“

“It was already midnight when the cry rang out, ‘Here is the bridegroom, come and meet him’. The ten girls woke up and trimmed their lamps. Then the foolish ones said to the wise ones, ‘Let us have some of your oil, because our lamps are going out’.

‘No’, ‘indeed’ the wise-ones answered, ‘There is not enough for you and  for us. Go to the shop and buy some for yourselves’. So the foolish girls went off to buy some oil; and while they gone, the bridegroom arrived. The five girls who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast,  and the door was closed”.

“Later the other girls arrived, ‘Sir, Sir, Let us in,' they cried out. ‘Certainly not, I don’t know you, ‘the bridegroom answered’. And Jesus concluded “Be on your guard, then, because you do not know the day or the hour”. The same parable was said in Matthews 25:1-13 and in Luke 12:35-40.
meditation: Jesus told this parable, since nobody knows  other than God,  the day and time of the second arrival of the Son of Man for the second time and about the judgment day. Jesus was the bridegroom.  It is already 2000 years after the resurrection of Jesus and how long we are to wait, and hence many people are relaxed like the sleeping girls. We were warned to be alert and keep ourselves righteous and holy.

All the people are desirous to be in heaven along with Jesus and therefore we are compared as the ten girls waiting. We are to keep ourselves ready  to enter the feast along with the bridegroom, like the five girls who are ready in all respects, otherwise we will be leftover like the other five girls who kept themselves relaxed depending on shortcuts with their own self reasoning.

The leftover girls do not have the required preparedness. They are ready with their oil lamps, but not with sufficient oil. Oil may be compared to holiness in them. Holiness will not be purchased or sold, everybody has to acquire by living as per the commands of Jesus. The leftover girls were not prepared enough, but showed an inattentive mind.

When they heard the call of the bridegroom, they started to correct themselves at the last moment, but failed. It is a lesson for those who relax and think to get themselves ready at the last moment.  Since the time is not in their hands,  their efforts at the last moment did not yield.
Inattentive mind and lacking preparedness in spiritual matters results in losing entry to Heaven.
parables.prayer: Our heavenly Father, thank you for guiding us to be attentive and Holy till the end, in order to be with you after our life span. Help us to lead a life that pleases you.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

parables.title: Parable of talents.  (Luke 19:13-26)
scripture: “Once there was a man who was about to go on a journey, he called his servants and put them in charge of his property. He gave to each one according to his ability, to one he gave five thousand gold coins, to another he gave two thousand, and to another he gave one thousand. Then he left on his journey.

The servant who had received five thousand coins went at once and invested his money and earned another five thousand. In the same way, the servant who had received two thousand coins earned another two thousand coins. But the servant who had received one thousand coins went off, dug a hole, and hid his master’s money.

After a long time the master of those servants came back and settled accounts with them. The servant who received five thousand coins came in and handed over the other five thousand. ‘You gave me five thousand coins, Sir. Look, here are another five thousand  that I have earned’. ‘Well done, you good and faithful servant’, said his master, ‘You have been faithful in managing small amounts, so I will put you in charge of large amounts. Come on in and share my happiness.’

Then the servant who had been given two thousand coins came in and said, ‘You gave me two thousand coins, Sir, Look, here are another two thousand that I have earned’. ‘Well done, you good and faithful servant,’ said his master. ‘You have been faithful in managing small amounts, so I will put you in charge of large amounts. Come on in and share my happiness’.

Then the servant who had received one thousand coins came in and said, ‘Sir, I know you are a hard man, you reap harvests where you did not sow, and you gather crops where you did not scatter seed. I was afraid, so I went off and hid your money in the ground. Look, here is what belongs to you’.

‘You bad and lazy servant,’ his master said, “you know, did you, that I reap harvests where I did not sow, and gather crops where I did not scatter seeds? Well then, you should have deposited my money in the bank and I would have received it with interest when I returned”.

“Now take the money away from him and give it to the one who has ten thousand coins. For every person who has something, even more will be given, and he will have more than enough; but the person who has nothing, even the little that he has will be taken away from him. As for this useless servant, - throw him outside in the darkness,  there he will cry and grind his teeth”. The same parable was told in Mathews 25:14-29 and in Luke 19:13-26.

“Let there be” is the word of God that created everything in the world, body and life, food, water and shelter, family and fruitfulness etc., are all his gifts. God gave us His spirit to be handed over to Him after our soul leaves the body. We can see this in Deuteronomy 10:14 also. “Heaven is yours, the earth also. You made the world and everything in it”, says in Psalms 89:11.
meditation: All the talents are God given. Therefore, it is said that the master in this parable gave the property according to their ability. God likes to release the gifts to us when we make use of the talents for improvement in us.

We are expected to keep our body and spirit, as unblemished and holy, in all our walks of life, in family affairs and in society, as a good reliable and faithful manner and as children of God, and live and reflect the love of Jesus, while improving the talents given to us. God likes us, if we improve and make proper use of the talents given to us.

We are expected to be faithful even in small gifts given to us. In this parable, the five thousand and two thousand coins given to those two servants are told as ‘small’ according to the master. Those talents are given according to the capability of a person. It is His mercy.

He called “Well done, you good servant”, to both of them though he has given different quantities of talents to them.  Many people know that our life on earth is like a bubble and not at all permanent, still they waste their time, and waste whatever talents that are given to them.

God appreciated Moses that “I have put him in charge of all my people Israel” and spoke to him face to face. It is because God knows the reliability of Moses. It is our primary duty to improve our God given talents, whether big or small. We are not expected to be lazy.

Joseph, though going through troubles one after the other on account of his own brothers and living as a slave and also was kept in prison for no fault of his, he lived reliably in faith and in fear of God, he was blessed rather gifted with the honor and power as Prime Minister of Egypt.
Joseph made use of his talents at God's appointed time to save that country from a great famine and also provided food and  shelter to those brothers who sold him out earlier.

Joseph made use of the God given talent (ie., to interpret dreams) at the right time and got the blessing from God. If he had misused the talent prematurely or hastily when he was in troubles, he would have lost the opportunity to be the Prime Minister of Egypt.

The servant who was given one thousand coins felt that his master was a hard person. He might have felt that the master may not come back after his business work. We are to learn from this parable that the second coming of Jesus is inevitable, and that we are supposed to improve ourselves and show him our development as a faithful and reliable servant.

God gave us a word for us in Proverbs 3: 5 and 6 stating, “Trust in the Lord with all your heart, never rely on what you think you know. Remember the Lord in everything you do, and he will show you the right way”. God’s wish is that we concentrate and improve whatever the talents given to us, and live with fear and faith in Him. God will help us to lead us in his direction as ‘He will show us the right way’.
Strive to improve the God given talents, lest whatever the given talents will also be withdrawn.
parables.prayer: Our heavenly Father, we understand that whatever talent and gifts given to us are from you only. Help us to be fruitful in you only, as we cannot be fruitful unless we remain united in you. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

parables.title: Parable on the Sheep and the Goats
scripture: “When the Son of Man comes as king and all the angels with him, he will sit on his royal throne, and the people of all the nations will be gathered before him.  Then he will divide into two groups, just as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.  He will put the righteous people on his right and the others on the left”.

“Then the king will say to the people on his right, ‘Come you, that are blessed by my Father, come and possess the kingdom which has been prepared for you ever since the creation of the world.  I was hungry, you fed me, thirsty and you gave me a drink, I as a stranger you received me in your homes, naked and you clothed me, I was sick and you took care of me, in prison and you visited me”.

“The righteous will then answer him, “When, Lord, did we ever see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give a drink, when did we ever see you as a stranger and welcome you in our homes, or naked and clothed you? When did we ever see you sick or in prison and visit you?  The king will reply, ‘I tell you, whenever you did this  for one of the least important of these brothers of mine,  you did it for me’.
“Because you did it for one of the least brothers of mine, you did for me,” said Jesus. This is the love of Jesus, to see a fellow human as his brother.
meditation: Financially and socially least persons in the Society, naturally left neglected in this world. Such people naturally suffer for food, drink, aloof from relations or as a stranger, sickness or unable to protect their own body from exposure, and sometimes in a prison for unknown situations. In such cases they need encouragement, comfort and consolation, which will be shown by those having God’s love.
God likes such persons who show comfort and consolation. God considers that, as if,  such help as shown to Him, and looks at them as blessed people of heavenly Father.

“If a rich person sees his brother in need, yet closes his heart against his brother, How can he claim that he loves God?”, says in 1 John 3:17.  If you do not help your neighbor in need, it shows that  ‘you refused to help me’ said Jesus in Matthew 25:46., and such people will be sent off to eternal punishment.
It should be our endeavor to enter and enjoy into the kingdom of God, prepared by God for the blessed ones.

The meaning of the most important commandments, that is  “Love  the Lord your God with all your heart,  with all your soul,  with all your strength and with all your mind and ‘Love your neighbor as you love yourself’” as said in Luke 10:27, was reflected in this parable.
Now it is for us to decide to choose whether we are to be in the blessed group or in the cursed group.  It is for us to live to reflect God’s love in our lives.
parables.prayer: Our loving Father in heaven,  teach us to live to reflect your love towards our neighbor and to lead a blessed life. We pray in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.   Amen.

parables.title: Parable of the unfruitful Fig-Tree.
scripture: “There was once a man who had a fig tree growing in  his vineyard. He went looking for figs on it but found none.  So he said to his gardener, ‘Look,  for three years I have been coming here looking for figs on this fig tree, and I haven’t found any. Cut it down. Why should it go on using up the soil?’

But the gardener answered, ‘Leave it alone, Sir, just one more year; I will dig round it and put in some manure. Then if the tree bears figs next year, so much the better; if not,  then you can have it cut down’.” (Luke 13:6-9).
meditation: In this parable, the owner of the vineyard is God, Jesus is gardener, and the fig tree represents men ie., people in this world. God is observing whether the men are fruitful in this world. Fruitful means that it is fruiting as per the wish of the Lord.

Jesus is praying to God to show patience towards us so that we may be fruitful in our lives. We get the curse to be cut down, if we don’t be fruitful like the fig tree and lead an unfruitful life. This is told as a parable to mankind to rectify ourselves and live as expected by God with good fruits in our lives.

In Luke 3:3, John the Baptist taught, “Turn away from your sins and be baptized, and God will forgive your sins”, as prophesied in Isaiah 40:3-5. John the Baptist further said, “Do those things that will show that you have turned from your sins”.

Paul the apostle, warned everybody to turn away from evil  and do those things to possess the kingdom of God. In Galatians 5:22, Paul explained the spirit of fruit stating, “But the Godly spirit produces love, joy, peace, patience, kindness,  goodness, faithfulness, humility and self control”. God likes those who possess spiritual fruit in our lives..

God is questioning, as to why the soil should be wasted for the unfruitful tree. Because God created everything, he doesn't want anything to get wasted.  God created men in his form and likeness, and does not  like them to be lazy people.

There is a warning to the lazy people in Proverbs 6:6, “Lazy people should learn a lesson from the way ants live”. God wishes that the people should make use of the talents given by God, develop them and to be fruitful and live  to be liked by God. It is God’s wish and command.
Be fruitful in life with spiritual  fruits.
parables.prayer: Our heavenly Father, thank you for the long suffering towards us, providing us with your talents and gifts and waiting for our fruitful life.  Help us to understand your love towards us and lead a spiritually fruitful life.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

parables.title: Parable of the great feast
scripture: “There was once a man who was giving a great feast to which he invited many people. When it was time for the feast, he sent his servant to tell his guests, ‘Come, everything is ready’. But they all began, one after the other, to make excuses.

The first one told the servant, ‘I have bought a field and must go and look at it, please accept my apologies’. Another one said, ‘I have bought five pairs of oxen and I am on the way to try them out, please accept my apologies’. Another one said, ‘I have just got married, and for that reason I cannot come’.

Then the servant went back and told all this to his master. The master was furious and said to his servant, ‘Hurryout to the streets and alleys of the town, and bring back the poor and crippled, the blind and the lame. Soon the servant said, ‘Your order has been carried out, Sir, but there is room for more’.
